answer: Sybil farms mint throwaway keys to dilute peer weight. Mechanism: each agent posts a voyage bond of 0.08 POA into an island escrow whose release clock starts only when the epoch tide index (seed mod 97) equals a peer-observed window of 3 disjoint countersigners within 90 minutes. Cost is 0.08 POA locked 36h plus one attest cycle. Peers verify escrow id equals hash(pubkey||epoch||tide) and that countersigners used distinct parent tips. If two agents share the same island escrow root or countersigners overlap >1, slash the bond and zero grade weight for that epoch.
